Question: Assalaamaliakum Pl. let me know whether animal sacificing as SADQA (ie after an accident life has been saved) is justified as per Islamic laws? Answer ID: 9054 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1155/1155=M/1429) It is allowed to slaughter animal in the name of Allah and distribute the meat as charity.
